steps.name: Step 0 (setup) — create the 'issue_details'/'normalized_issue' custom state variables via the STATE panel, so they're selectable in the State modifier node's Input/Output combos later
Step 1 — Add a State modifier node via canvas '+' button -> 'State modifier'
Step 2 — 'Verify State modifier node panel shows' is checked inline: config renders directly on the canvas card, no click-to-open action exists
Step 3 — In "Jinja Template" field enter the classification template

Step 4 — 'Expand Variables to clean section (if applicable)': CLARIFICATION — live-confirmed this is a plain multi-select combobox (same component as Input/Output), not an expandable/accordion section; asserted as present + openable as a dropdown instead
Step 5 — Set Input combobox — add variable "issue_details"
Step 6 — Set Output combobox — add variable "normalized_issue"
Step 7 — Save the pipeline; verify no console errors and a 201 Created response
